responsibility: Implements the LynxOS-specific rs6000 target configuration. It replaces the SysV4-derived preprocessor, cc1, assembler, and linker specs with LynxOS variants, enforces the big-endian and AIX-style structure-return conventions expected by LynxOS, disables unsupported TLS and relocatable fixup assumptions, and adjusts debugging and crt helper behavior for this operating system.
